REAL_DEFECT_FIXED.what: opportunity ranking was decided by a vanity metric
REAL_DEFECT_FIXED.evidence_from_cycle_88: process_opportunity returned expected_roi.roi_pct = 43,649,900.0 for a real ACCEPTED niche
REAL_DEFECT_FIXED.root_cause: estimate_roi() only guarded against a falsy denominator. The only production cost this factory can genuinely log for a generated digital product is the AI call cost (real observed average $0.0004). Dividing a ~$174 net by $0.0004 yields a huge ratio.
REAL_DEFECT_FIXED.why_it_mattered: evolution_engine.build_evolution_report() SORTS opportunities by exactly roi_pct descending, so this arithmetic decided which niche ranked first. estimate_pre_acceptance_roi() runs at scoring time, so it also fed opportunity selection. The system was rewarding a near-zero denominator over sales feasibility - precisely the failure mode the directive named.

fix.plan.py: added MIN_MEANINGFUL_COST_USD = 1.00. Below the floor, roi_pct is set to None with roi_basis='NOT_MEANINGFUL' and a stated reason. The genuinely measured figures (net_profit_after_fees, production_cost_usd, expected_net_after_cost) are still returned unchanged and still marked REAL - nothing measured was discarded, only the meaningless ratio withheld.
fix.evolution_engine.py: the sort no longer assumes roi_pct is a number: real percentages rank above withheld ones, with expected_net_after_cost as the tiebreak, and roi_pct is carried through honestly as None.
fix.pipeline.py: report rendering no longer prints None%; it states plainly that the ratio is not meaningful.

measurement_root_cause.classification: ARCHITECTURALLY UNREACHABLE - not absent, not unobserved, not broken code
measurement_root_cause.evidence: the page-view beacon is present and correctly coded on the deployed pages, but it posts to a relative /api/page-view which on the GitHub Pages host returns HTTP 404. Pages serves a static tree and has no Express handler.
measurement_root_cause.why_unknown_not_zero: the beacon's .catch(()=>{}) swallows the failure, so nothing is recorded either way. A confirmed 0 and an unobserved stream are indistinguishable, so visits and leads stay UNKNOWN rather than being converted to zero.
measurement_root_cause.what_would_repair_it: publicly hosting the Express server, or a third-party analytics account. Neither can be created without the owner, so it was not faked, stubbed or papered over.
